propositions: binding_lifecycle.py contains two legacy config-ownership exceptions: an ambient os.environ.get read and an _env_int shim for RECONCILER_ABSENT_RETIRE_GRACE, both moved from binding_store.py by RP-02 S2 and missed by RP-04 S7.3.a
The owned accessor resolve_absent_retire_grace() already exists in rebar._config_sources and is re-exported through the public rebar.config facade with identical semantics
Replacing the _env_int call in note_absent with resolve_absent_retire_grace() from rebar.config and removing the dead _env_int helper eliminates the ambient read entirely
The _DEFAULT_ABSENT_RETIRE_GRACE constant must be retained because binding_store.py aliases it and test_no_resurrection_after_confirmed_delete_3b5f.py asserts against it
Removing both binding_lifecycle.py rows from LEGACY_EXCEPTIONS leaves the whitelist EMPTY and completes the config-ownership drain
Absence-retire behavior must be byte-preserved: default 3, clamp >= 1, malformed/absent env falls back to default
